decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm's core wafer-processing capabilities in a growing industry, this product likely performs near aspiration and is not an obvious candidate for problemistic search away from the core.

This carrier wafer is a close fit with the established business, serves a clear handling need for existing customers, and should be easy to retain given the firm's technical base and some organisational slack.
Although technologically ambitious, it was presented as a flagship direction, so management would likely continue backing it unless results clearly fell short of aspiration.
The off-the-shelf wafer brand is closely related to the firm's existing offer and strategic direction, making it likely to be kept as a low-risk way to broaden sales within the core market.

Because glass-based circuit boards are more distant from the firm's established niche, any performance shortfall would more readily trigger reallocation of resources back to the stronger core and nearer-term development projects.
